## Current PM

🟢 **`os-support-ai`** · `session_01WGufziB6Ujr9PbkHyigMv1` (project thread "Run PM dispatch spec seat 2"), seated 2026-11-05T13:41Z. - Posture, ledger and round reports live in the project (pointer only).
